name: Proactive AMCP
description: Agent Memory Continuity Protocol — encrypted checkpoints to IPFS, identity verification, memory integrity, resurrection detection

enabled.description: Enable the AMCP plugin (code-level enforcement layer)

autoCheckpoint.description: Automatically create checkpoints on lifecycle events (gateway start, session end, context threshold)

checkpointIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval between automatic checkpoints in milliseconds. 0 = no time-based checkpoints (event-driven only)

contextThreshold.description: Context usage percentage (0-100) that triggers an automatic checkpoint before compaction

ipfsPinningService.description: IPFS pinning provider for checkpoint storage. 'solvr' = free for registered agents, 'pinata' = Pinata cloud, 'local' = filesystem only

encryptionKeyPath.description: Path to KERI identity file used for checkpoint encryption and signing

checkpointCooldownMs.description: Minimum cooldown between any two checkpoints in milliseconds (default: 5 minutes)

enabled.description: Enable memory integrity monitoring (hash baseline + change detection)

promptInjectionScan.description: Scan memory files for prompt injection patterns

autoRestore.description: Automatically restore from checkpoint when tampering is detected

autoInject.description: Automatically inject identity into agent context on start and resurrection

verifyOnStart.description: Verify KERI identity integrity on gateway start (block operations if invalid)

autoDetect.description: Automatically detect context wipes and inject recovery instructions

injectRecoveryPrompt.description: Inject recovery prompt into new session after context wipe detection

enabled.label: Enable AMCP
enabled.help: Master switch for the code-level enforcement layer. Skill layer works independently.

autoCheckpoint.label: Auto-Checkpoint
autoCheckpoint.help: Checkpoint automatically on context threshold, session end, and gateway lifecycle events

checkpointIntervalMs.label: Checkpoint Interval (ms)
checkpointIntervalMs.help: Time-based checkpoint interval. Set to 0 for event-driven only. Example: 3600000 = 1 hour

contextThreshold.label: Context Threshold (%)
contextThreshold.help: When context usage exceeds this percentage, trigger a checkpoint before compaction

ipfsPinningService.label: IPFS Pinning Service
ipfsPinningService.help: Solvr is free for registered agents. Pinata requires a separate account. Local stores on disk only.

encryptionKeyPath.label: Identity Key Path
encryptionKeyPath.help: Path to your KERI identity file (identity.json). Loss of this file makes checkpoints unrecoverable.

checkpointCooldownMs.label: Checkpoint Cooldown (ms)
checkpointCooldownMs.help: Minimum time between checkpoints to prevent excessive pinning. Default: 5 minutes

memoryIntegrity.enabled.label: Memory Integrity
memoryIntegrity.enabled.help: Monitor memory files for unauthorized changes using hash baselines

memoryIntegrity.promptInjectionScan.label: Injection Scanning
memoryIntegrity.promptInjectionScan.help: Scan memory files for prompt injection patterns (identity hijacking, action directives, etc.)

memoryIntegrity.autoRestore.label: Auto-Restore on Tamper
memoryIntegrity.autoRestore.help: Automatically restore tampered files from last clean checkpoint. Use with caution.

identity.autoInject.label: Auto-Inject Identity
identity.autoInject.help: Inject KERI identity into agent context on start and resurrection

identity.verifyOnStart.label: Verify Identity on Start
identity.verifyOnStart.help: Validate KERI identity integrity when gateway starts. Blocks operations if invalid.

resurrection.autoDetect.label: Auto-Detect Context Wipe
resurrection.autoDetect.help: Detect context clears and session restarts to trigger resurrection flow

resurrection.injectRecoveryPrompt.label: Inject Recovery Prompt
resurrection.injectRecoveryPrompt.help: Automatically inject recovery instructions with checkpoint CID after context wipe
